python3 -c "
import urllib.request, json

def geocode(q):
    url = f'https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q={urllib.parse.quote(q)}&format=json'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'ResearchBot/1.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))

print('National Air and Space Museum:', geocode('National Air and Space Museum Washington DC'))
print('Fire Station 301 DCA:', geocode('Fire Station 301 Ronald Reagan'))
print('Cleveland Elementary School:', geocode('Cleveland Elementary School Washington DC'))
"
